summary: Product review section with rating summaries, sorting, filtering, and review management.
features: Multiple star style options (Accent, Primary, Yellow, Black)
Star rating filters with clickable progress bars
Review modal and management with publishing approval
shortDescription: The Review Section provides a comprehensive area for displaying and managing customer reviews on product detail pages. Users can browse reviews with sorting and filtering by star rating using interactive progress bar charts that double as filter buttons. The 'Write a Review' button triggers a submission modal. For merchants, the component supports moderation workflows including customer service responses and pre-publication approval to maintain review quality.
